stem.text: What is the correct order of locations in the cell for the production of an extracellular enzyme?

A.text: nucleus $\rightarrow$ ribosome $\rightarrow$ rough endoplasmic reticulum $\rightarrow$ Golgi body

B.text: ribosome $\rightarrow$ nucleus $\rightarrow$ Golgi body $\rightarrow$ rough endoplasmic reticulum

C.text: ribosome $\rightarrow$ rough endoplasmic reticulum $\rightarrow$ nucleus $\rightarrow$ Golgi body

D.text: rough endoplasmic reticulum $\rightarrow$ nucleus $\rightarrow$ Golgi body $\rightarrow$ ribosome
